summary: The independent fractal-web CI lanes run in four parallel streams instead of one after another.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: CI-only change to how the fractal-web lanes are scheduled; every lane still runs and must pass. No application, API or user-visible behavior change.

recovery.detail: Reverting runs the lanes in sequence again; nothing to recover.
